definitions.explanation: The real nature or identity of something. Almost exclusively used in the negative expression 得体の知れない (of unknown nature, mysterious, suspicious).

examples.japanese: {得体|えたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}れない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
{得体|えたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}れない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われた→襲う：01915_osou⟧。
examples.english: I was overcome by a mysterious anxiety.

examples.japanese: {得体|えたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}れない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦うろうろ→うろうろ：05168_urouro⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}した→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧。
examples.english: A suspicious man was loitering in front of the house, so I called the police.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used in the set phrase {得体|えたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}れない→知る：00458_shiru⟧, meaning "of unknown nature," "mysterious," or "unidentifiable." This expression modifies nouns to convey suspicion, eeriness, or the unsettling quality of something whose true identity cannot be determined. The standalone word {得体|えたい} is rarely used outside this pattern.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {得体|えたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}れない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a suspicious/mysterious person
- {得体|えたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}れない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧: a vague, inexplicable anxiety
- {得体|えたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}れない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧: an unidentifiable thing
- {得体|えたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}れない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧: an unknown liquid
